description: Create a new SQL view named 'CustomerPurchaseSummary' in the Chinook database. The view must summarize purchase data by joining the 'Customer' and 'Invoice' tables. It should include the following columns: 'CustomerId' (from Customer), 'FullName' (concatenation of FirstName and LastName separated by a space), 'Email' (from Customer), 'InvoiceCount' (count of invoices), and 'TotalSpent' (sum of invoice totals). Results must be grouped by the customer fields. You can use the SQL command window (Tools > SQL) or the Query Design View (Create View). Save the database file after creating the view.
